Our Safe Space Agreement

Please review our zero-tolerance guidelines to keep our neighborhood safe and welcoming.

handshake
1. Code of Conduct
chevron_right

Be respectful, kind, and honest with your neighbors. We have a zero-tolerance policy for objectionable content or abusive users. The listing of illegal goods, weapons, drugs, and adult services is strictly prohibited. Any harassment, discrimination, illicit substances, dangerous behavior, or offensive postings will result in immediate permanent suspension from the platform.

home
2. Exchange Safety
chevron_right

Always arrange exchanges in safe, public, and well-lit locations (such as local parks, cafes, or community centers). Only share cross-streets or general vicinities; never share your exact home address or apartment number.

gavel
3. Liability Disclaimer
chevron_right
Corner Swaps acts solely as a passive facilitator to connect community members. We do not inspect, verify, or guarantee the safety, legality, quality, or existence of any listings, items, or skills exchanged. By using this platform, you explicitly acknowledge and agree that all exchanges are conducted entirely at your own risk. You hereby release Corner Swaps, its founders, and affiliates from any and all liability, claims, disputes, damages, or losses arising from or in connection with user exchanges, transactions, or communications. Furthermore, you are solely responsible for reporting any taxable income or barter exchanges to tax authorities at their Fair Market Value (FMV) in compliance with provincial and federal tax laws. By scrolling and agreeing to this disclaimer, you accept full responsibility for all activities, taxation requirements, and risk associated with your user interactions.
security
4. Privacy Policy
chevron_right

We protect your personal information and approximate location data using standard security practices in compliance with the British Columbia Personal Information Protection Act (BC PIPA) and federal privacy laws. We never sell your data, and you can delete your account at any time.

location_on

Anchor Your Place

Corner Swaps uses your location to connect you with nearby neighbors.

verified_user Approximate Location Safeguard

To safeguard your personal privacy, we default to coarse location. Your coordinates are obfuscated on the map by several hundred meters, indicating a broad neighborhood vicinity rather than your exact residence.

security

Safe Swap Zones

Always prioritize your safety by meeting neighbors in busy, well-lit, public locations.

verified_user Recommended Swap Spots

We strongly recommend completing exchanges at crowded, well-lit public spots such as local coffee shops, library lobbies, or designated municipal safe swap zones. Never invite strangers directly to your home.

Definitions & Guidance

favorite Karma

Karma points reflect your active contributions, reliability, and good standing in the community. You earn karma by listing offerings (including free items and gifts), sharing services, helping neighbors, and completing successful swaps. Higher karma highlights you as a trusted neighbor and unlocks special badges!

handshake Swaps

Completed Swaps track the total number of items or services you have successfully swapped with other neighbors.

card_giftcard Gifts

Gifts are offered for free. Gift economy keeps our neighbourhood going! Giving gifts earns you karma points. What goes around, comes around :).

groups Groups

Make group chats by adding friends for recurring exchanges, such as regular book swaps, food exchanges, or skill shares.

schedule Time sensitive

Make swaps within 48 hours, so we are respecting neighbours time. If a swap is not made in 48 hours, the chat will be deleted.

chat Chats

Once a swap is made, chats are deleted. You can save a listing if you would like to go back to it, but aren’t ready to swap yet.

money_off Cashless

We ask that all swaps are made without money. We support a neighbourhood economy that is based on giving.

school Skill shares and expertise

Everyone is good at something! Consider adding skills shares or expertise to your offerings. These are skills you can share lessons on, or areas you can provide knowledgeable guidance or tips.

Neighbourhood Tips

Every listing you share builds your public neighborhood trust rating and inspires others to trade. Start by putting out what you can share!
You can share a wide range of offerings: lend tools and appliances to reduce waste, offer lessons or tutoring services, share professional advice, organize community playdates, or trade items you no longer need.
Gifts are items that are given away for free. Giving gifts to your neighbors is a great way to support the community and earns you extra Karma points!
Always meet in well-lit public spaces, share nearby cross-streets instead of your exact home address, remember that swaps are entirely cashless, and immediately report any safety concerns in chat.
  • Verify Profiles: Always trade with community members who have verified badges and higher vouch counts.
  • Public Meetups: Conduct swaps during daylight hours in busy, well-lit public areas (e.g., local coffee shops or community centers).
  • Secure Communication: Keep all discussions inside the Barterland secure chat; never share your phone number or email early on.
  • Share Your Location: Let a friend or family member know where and when you are going to meet someone for a swap.
  • Address Privacy: Meet at nearest major cross-streets rather than giving out your home address, especially for high-value swaps.
  • Trust Your Instincts: If a deal feels suspicious or uncomfortable, cancel the meetup immediately and report the user in-app.

Safety Tips

location_on Meet in Public Spaces

Always arrange meetups in well-lit, busy public locations such as parks, coffee shops, or community centres. Avoid meeting at your home or a stranger's home for a first exchange.

home_pin Protect Your Address

Share nearby cross-streets or a landmark instead of your exact home address. Your personal address is private — no swap is worth compromising your home security.

money_off All Swaps Are Cashless

Barterland is a cashless platform. Never accept or send money as part of a swap. If someone asks you for money, please report them immediately. Cashless exchanges protect everyone and keep our community fair.

sentiment_very_satisfied Trust Your Instincts

If something feels off, it probably is. You are never obligated to complete a swap. Cancel at any time and report any behaviour that makes you uncomfortable — your safety always comes first.

group Bring a Friend

For your first exchange with a new neighbour, consider bringing a friend or family member along. There is strength in numbers, and it helps build community bonds too!

flag Report Safety Concerns

Report any threatening messages, suspicious activity, or safety concerns directly in chat using the flag icon, or contact our moderation team. We take all reports seriously and act swiftly to protect our community.

chat Keep Conversations on Platform

For your safety and our community records, keep all swap communications within the Barterland chat. This helps resolve disputes and ensures accountability on both sides.

fact_check Verify Items Before Swapping

Inspect items at the point of exchange before completing a swap. If an item is not as described, you are not obligated to proceed. Honest descriptions protect everyone and build lasting trust.

school Skill & Service Exchanges

When offering or receiving skills and services, ensure both parties have agreed to the scope and expectations beforehand. Barterland is not liable for outcomes of skill or service exchanges — participants engage at their own risk and discretion.

gavel Platform Disclaimer

Barterland facilitates peer-to-peer exchanges between neighbours and does not guarantee the quality, safety, or legality of any item or service offered. Users are solely responsible for their interactions and exchanges. By using this platform, you agree to our Terms of Use and Community Guidelines.
